rationale: The current instructions say 'explicit input schemas' but never mention additionalProperties:false, so the agent treats it as optional. Embedding the requirement directly in the main tool-building directive makes it impossible to overlook during schema construction.
expected_effect: Agent will set additionalProperties:false on every tool inputSchema it defines, satisfying the strict schema contract verifier on customer-directory, notes-store, and paginated-catalog.
regression_risk: Very low. The change only narrows existing schema guidance; tools that already pass continue to declare required fields and validate inputs identically.
